mechanism: The reporting must distinguish data transfer from application and infrastructure failures and document which customer-impact claims were confirmed by regulators or the bank.
system: The incident asks how a bank proves operational resilience before a one-way migration that simultaneously changes the experience of millions of customers.
memory: A disastrous weekend launch is memorable, but board oversight, supplier relationships and months of remediation make the fuller accountability record.

title: RBS 2012: A Batch Failure Across Millions of Accounts
dek: A software change disrupted overnight processing and left customers without reliable balances, payments or access to funds.
event: A technology failure at RBS Group in 2012 disrupted account processing across several bank brands and delayed payments for millions of customers. This draft follows the software change, batch backlog, recovery effort, customer harm and regulatory findings.
mechanism: The article must distinguish the initiating scheduler or processing problem from the operational difficulty of replaying a large backlog without corrupting account state.
system: The outage asks how staffing, legacy knowledge and change control protect a bank whose overnight systems quietly mediate wages, bills and cash access.
memory: The technical trigger is often summarized in one line, while the social consequences show why back-office software is public infrastructure in practice.

title: Equifax: A Known Vulnerability Inside a Credit Bureau
dek: The 2017 breach joined missed patching, disputed asset visibility and the unusual harm of data people could not withdraw.
event: Equifax disclosed in 2017 that attackers had accessed sensitive personal data through a vulnerable web application. This draft follows the public vulnerability notice, patch process, certificate and monitoring failures, discovery and consumer response.
mechanism: The reporting must distinguish the exploited Apache Struts flaw from the separate controls that could have prevented, detected or limited access, and reconcile changing estimates of affected people.
system: The breach asks what accountability applies when a company aggregates identity data about people who are not ordinary voluntary customers.
memory: The patch headline is accurate but incomplete; inventory, scanning, detection and breach-notification choices determine why one missed update became systemic harm.

title: Target 2013: Vendor Credentials and Malware at the Checkout
dek: Attackers moved from a third-party account into a retailer's payment environment and extracted card data during the holiday season.
event: Target's 2013 breach exposed payment-card and customer data after attackers used credentials associated with a vendor and installed malware on point-of-sale systems. This draft follows network access, lateral movement, security alerts, exfiltration and disclosure.
mechanism: The article must distinguish the vendor entry point, internal segmentation, point-of-sale memory scraping and later theft of non-card customer data.
system: The breach tests whether third-party access and security monitoring are governed as business-critical controls or treated as technical background.
memory: The HVAC-vendor detail attracts attention, while ignored or misunderstood alerts and network architecture explain the scale of compromise.

title: SolarWinds: A Trusted Update as the Intrusion Path
dek: The 2020 campaign turned software build integrity and delayed detection into risks shared across government and industry.
event: A sophisticated espionage campaign compromised SolarWinds' Orion software build process and distributed malicious code through signed updates, disclosed in 2020. This draft follows the build intrusion, customer installation, selective follow-on activity and discovery.
mechanism: The reporting must distinguish organizations that received the tainted update from those where attackers conducted additional access, and keep attribution language tied to official assessments.
system: The incident asks how customers verify trusted software when authenticity controls can confirm that an update came from a vendor but not that the vendor's build was clean.
memory: The vendor name became shorthand for the whole campaign, obscuring the difference between supply-chain exposure, actual compromise and later remediation.

title: BCCI: A Bank Built Across the Gaps Between Regulators
dek: The global bank's 1991 closure exposed hidden ownership, false accounting and supervision divided across jurisdictions.
event: The Bank of Credit and Commerce International was closed by regulators in 1991 after investigations uncovered extensive fraud and concealed control. This draft follows its international structure, audit relationships, related lending, regulatory warnings and coordinated closure.
mechanism: The article must distinguish proven accounting manipulation and criminal findings from the many political allegations attached to the bank.
system: BCCI asks how a financial institution can exploit the space between national supervisors when no regulator sees the complete group.
memory: Its notoriety invites a catalog of sensational clients, while the institutional design of fragmented oversight is the more transferable story.

title: Northern Rock: Wholesale Funding and the Queue Outside the Branch
dek: The 2007 run made a bank's dependence on short-term markets visible to retail depositors and the public safety net.
event: Northern Rock sought emergency support in 2007 after wholesale funding markets tightened, prompting the first visible run on a British bank in generations. This draft follows the funding model, disclosure, depositor behavior, guarantees and nationalization.
mechanism: The reporting must separate solvency from liquidity at each stage and explain how securitization and short-term funding supported rapid mortgage growth.
system: The case asks how central bank confidentiality, deposit insurance and public communication interact when assistance itself can signal danger.
memory: Photographs of queues became the symbol, but balance-sheet structure and incomplete deposit protection explain why the queues formed.

title: Repo 105: How Lehman Made Leverage Disappear at Quarter End
dek: A short-lived balance-sheet maneuver turned legal form, accounting treatment and investor disclosure into a crisis record.
event: Before its 2008 bankruptcy, Lehman Brothers used transactions known as Repo 105 to temporarily remove assets and liabilities around reporting dates. This draft follows the transaction structure, legal opinion, internal concerns, audit treatment and examiner findings.
mechanism: The article must distinguish an ordinary repurchase agreement from the sale-accounting treatment used here and quantify effects only from supported period-specific records.
system: The episode asks whether financial reporting conveys economic leverage when a transaction is structured to satisfy a formal accounting boundary for only days.
memory: Repo 105 is often treated as the explanation for Lehman's collapse; the article must instead place it as a disclosure practice inside a much larger liquidity and asset-quality crisis.

title: Carillion: Thin Margins, Late Cash and the State as Customer
dek: The contractor's 2018 liquidation exposed aggressive accounting and the public consequences of outsourcing essential work.
event: Carillion entered compulsory liquidation in 2018 while carrying major construction and public-service contracts. This draft follows contract losses, revenue recognition, supplier payment, pension obligations, dividends, warnings and the government's contingency response.
mechanism: The reporting must distinguish cash flow, reported profit and order-book claims, and tie allegations about accounting or governance to parliamentary, regulatory or legal findings.
system: The collapse asks how government evaluates supplier resilience when low bids and complex contracts transfer delivery but not the public consequence of failure.
memory: Executive pay and dividends are visible symbols, while contract structure and audit challenge explain how the company appeared viable until it was not.

title: GM's Ignition Switch: A Part Changed Without a New Number
dek: A low-torque switch, disabled airbags and fragmented defect data delayed recognition of a safety problem across vehicle lines.
event: General Motors recalled millions of vehicles in 2014 over ignition switches that could move out of the run position and disable power and airbags. This draft follows early test failures, a design change, unchanged part numbering, crash data and delayed escalation.
mechanism: The article must distinguish loss of engine power, steering and braking assistance, and airbag nondeployment, while carefully attributing crash and death counts to the relevant review process.
system: The case asks how an organization recognizes a defect when legal, engineering, warranty and crash records each hold only a fragment and naming conventions conceal the change.
memory: A cheap component became the symbol, but information architecture and decision ownership explain the decade-long delay.

source.title: General Motors ignition switch recalls overview

title: Takata: An Airbag Inflator That Became Shrapnel
dek: Propellant degradation turned a safety device into a global recall spanning manufacturers, climates and years of incomplete evidence.
event: Takata airbag inflators were recalled on a vast scale after some ruptured during deployment and projected metal fragments into vehicle cabins. This draft follows propellant choice, moisture and temperature exposure, field incidents, testing and phased recall prioritization.
mechanism: The reporting must distinguish inflator families and failure mechanisms, and use dated regulator or manufacturer counts rather than one timeless global total.
system: The case tests traceability across a shared supplier when many automakers use related components and risk changes with age and climate.
memory: The enormous recall number communicates reach, but replacement capacity, owner contact and changing technical scope determined who remained exposed.

title: Tazreen Fashions: Locked Exits in a Global Supply Chain
dek: The 2012 Dhaka factory fire connected blocked escape routes to purchasing practices and audits far beyond the building.
event: Fire swept through the Tazreen Fashions factory near Dhaka in 2012, trapping workers in a multistory building. This draft follows ignition reports, alarms, exit access, management instructions, buyer relationships and the response after the fire.
mechanism: The article must map stairs, doors and stored material, distinguish confirmed buyers from disputed labels, and reconcile casualty figures through reliable records.
system: The fire asks whether social audits and sourcing contracts can detect conditions that workers experience daily but buyers encounter only through scheduled inspection.
memory: Images of workers at windows convey desperation, while subcontracting and purchasing pressure locate responsibility across a wider commercial system.

title: Rana Plaza: Cracks, Orders to Return and the Cost of a Delivery Schedule
dek: The 2013 collapse made structural alteration, worker coercion and global apparel sourcing part of one accountability chain.
event: Rana Plaza collapsed near Dhaka in 2013 after cracks were observed and garment workers were ordered back into the building. This draft follows building approvals, added floors, heavy machinery, the prior-day warning, evacuation decisions and rescue.
mechanism: The reporting must distinguish structural deficiencies from the immediate loading and vibration sequence and document which occupants did or did not reopen.
system: The disaster asks how brands, factory owners, building officials and workers share—or evade—authority when commercial deadlines conflict with visible danger.
memory: The collapse became a global symbol of fast fashion, but individual factory relationships and the implementation of later safety accords need specific evidence.

title: The 1973 Records Center Fire: Service Histories Without a Backup
dek: A blaze near St. Louis destroyed millions of military personnel files and shifted the burden of reconstruction onto veterans.
event: Fire burned for days at the National Personnel Records Center in 1973 and destroyed a large share of certain United States military personnel files. This draft follows building design, suppression limits, record arrangement, salvage and later reconstruction work.
mechanism: The article must identify which service branches and date ranges were most affected, distinguish destroyed from damaged records, and avoid implying every veteran file was lost.
system: The fire asks how a government values archival redundancy when a document may appear dormant until a person needs it decades later to prove eligibility or service.
memory: The absence of an exact ignition finding should not obscure the durable administrative harm created by a single concentrated paper archive.

source.title: National Personnel Records Center fire overview

title: Brazil's National Museum: Two Centuries of Collections in One Night
dek: The 2018 fire exposed deferred maintenance, weak protection and the irreversible loss hidden inside an institution's ordinary budget.
event: Fire devastated Brazil's National Museum in Rio de Janeiro in September 2018, destroying much of a vast natural-history and cultural collection. This draft follows electrical and fire-protection concerns, funding constraints, emergency access, salvage and rebuilding.
mechanism: The reporting must separate confirmed ignition evidence from broader institutional deficiencies and describe losses by collection rather than relying only on one percentage.
system: The disaster asks how societies account for low-frequency catastrophic risk when maintenance competes with visible programming and an archive's value cannot be replaced after loss.
memory: A few iconic surviving objects can support recovery but also obscure the countless specimens, languages and research records that disappeared.

source.title: National Museum of Brazil fire overview

title: The Cutter Incident: Live Poliovirus in a Vaccine Campaign
dek: A 1955 manufacturing failure caused disease just as mass vaccination was beginning, testing production control and public trust.
event: Some polio vaccine produced by Cutter Laboratories in 1955 contained active virus and caused paralysis and secondary transmission. This draft follows the inactivation process, safety testing, lot release, case recognition, recall and changes to manufacturing oversight.
mechanism: The article must distinguish vaccine-associated cases from community spread, explain the production and filtration problem carefully, and use historically supported counts.
system: The incident asks how regulators scale quality control when a successful scientific result moves rapidly into mass production across several manufacturers.
memory: The failure can be misused to erase the vaccine's overall impact; responsible reporting must preserve both the preventable manufacturing harm and the larger disease context.

title: Firestone and Ford: Tire Failures, Vehicle Rollover and Divided Data
dek: A wave of tread separations exposed how a component supplier, automaker and regulator interpreted warning patterns across a popular vehicle fleet.
event: Failures of certain Firestone tires fitted to Ford Explorers led to a major recall and investigations around 2000. This draft follows warranty and crash data, tire construction, inflation guidance, vehicle handling, manufacturing plants and the companies' competing explanations.
mechanism: The article must distinguish tread separation from rollover dynamics and compare failure rates by tire model, plant, climate and use without treating correlation as a complete causal finding.
system: The case asks who must integrate safety evidence when supplier and automaker each control only part of the product and have incentives to locate fault in the other part.
memory: Corporate accusations generated clear headlines, while fragmented field data and the interaction between tire and vehicle make the engineering record less tidy.

source.title: Firestone and Ford tire controversy overview
